text:
Maya Lin: Planning a quick canary publish in tonight's change window (20:00 UTC). Targets: python + ts SDKs. Need ops + docs signoff, and decision on including the legacy sync deprecation note in the canary release.
Oscar Reyes: I can run the publish and smoke. Tagging: v2.3.0-rc4-canary.
Priya Desai: I'll update the small docs blurb and release notes. Will push a one-line migration example.
Maya Lin: deploy-bot, schedule for 1719822400 and post status.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy #deploy-874 at 1719822400 for packages: redwood-sdk-python, @redwood/sdk-ts. CI: https://ci.internal/jobs/deploy-874 :rocket:
Oscar Reyes: publish plan:
```bash
make build-sdks && twine upload --repository testpypi dist/*rc4*
cd packages/sdk-ts && npm publish --tag canary
```
Priya Desai: release notes draft includes: bullets + deprecation note: "Legacy sync client deprecated; prefer async. Migration script: https://git.internal/migrate-sync"
Tom Gallagher: smoke checklist: auth refresh, streaming, embeddings, install/pin behavior. I'll run `./scripts/smoke/checks.sh`.
deploy-bot: deploy-874 started at 1719822400. build -> success. publish TS -> success. python upload -> success to testpypi.
Tom Gallagher: running smoke: streaming ok, embeddings ok, but token refresh shows 401 on one auth replica.
Maya Lin: hold propagation. Oscar, please disable canary routing and remove npm tag while we triage.
Oscar Reyes: done: disabled route `canary-2.3.0-rc4` and `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk-ts canary`.
deploy-bot: noted: route disabled.
Tom Gallagher: logs show `invalid_claims` on refresh for certain pods. Repro on two hosts.
Priya Desai: adding "Known issue" to release notes and guidance: restart auth sidecar. Docs PR incoming.
Maya Lin: decision: rollback canary artifacts and cut rc4.1 after fix. Oscar will cut rc4.1.
Oscar Reyes: will cut rc4.1 after auth PR merges. Rollback steps executed: remove npm tag, yank testpypi artifact, disable routing. Will rerun full smoke matrix after republish.
Priya Desai: doc note: for canary suggest explicit pins: `pip install redwood-sdk-python==2.3.0rc4` and `npm install @redwood/sdk-ts@canary`. For GA we'll ask for exact pins.
Maya Lin: thanks. Tracking ticket REL-221. Postmortem if regression reaches prod. Update this thread when rc4.1 is published. :white_check_mark:
